During an audit of FINSA—a multi-billion-dollar wood processing company—numerous violations in data storage and infrastructure security were identified.
We extracted all confidential and production files from their servers, totaling 800 GB. Following this, we completely halted operations by attacking the company’s virtualization.

Among the extracted data is now available:

    Internal production information across FINSA’s facilities
    Financial documents, databases, and reports
    Full employee information
    Wood processing materials and technologies
    Contracts with partners and their terms
    And much more.

We welcome anyone interested in purchasing all of this company’s data. Additionally, we are prepared to leak the files to the media, competitors, and legal firms for investigations and public lawsuits if you have any intentions toward this company. | Status: selling | $100,000

Revenue: $221.7 million

Momentum is a telecommunications company founded in 2001 that provides cloud-based communication solutions for businesses, specializing in cloud voice services, managed networks, SD-WAN solutions, and Microsoft Teams Phone integration. We gained access to a diagnostic and provisioning tool used by Momentum through a compromised Multi-Service Operator (MSO). Upon reconnaissance, we identified multiple critical vulnerabilities throughout the system. This tool controls internet and voice services for millions of users across global markets. We successfully accessed user data for every MSO, exposing personally identifiable information (PII) for over 7.5 million users. They didn't notice the prolonged access or the customer data dump for a while, but when we started deleting modems they noticed. They kept burning access and we gained it back, they'd burn it again. We have caused widespread outages (https://www.abc4.com/news/wasatch-front/eagle-mountain-internet-outage-cyberattack/). We now have had over 100,000 packages successfully deleted. That's 100,000+ people without internet service right now. Families, businesses, students all cut off from the digital world. This is the direct result of their negligence and failure to secure their systems. These services can be restored immediately with the click of a button on our tool but you must reach out. Click "View Affected MSOs" below to see the full list of compromised providers. Momentum management should contact us to discuss resolution. Affected MSOs can also contact us to have their users' data deleted from our database.

Revenue: $15.1 million

items.description: K&A Industries is a "secure identity architecture" company that manages the entire authentication lifecycle for government and enterprise clients. As a result, their own security weaknesses led to the compromise of sensitive personal data, biometric templates, and government contract data. K&A also provides PIV credentials to government agencies, such as the Los Alamos National Laboratory, which involves processing the personal data of federal employees. A breach of this data would trigger a cascade of legal, financial, and operational crises, leading to breach notification obligations under GDPR/government regulations, multimillion-dollar fines and class action lawsuits, loss of government contracts/CMMC status, and physical data breaches using cloned credentials at client sites.
